description: Cold enough that your breath goes and the back of your neck knows about it. Wooden boxes stacked to the ceiling on slatted racks, each one with a chalked name and a chalked time, and a mound of crushed ice in the corner under a tarpaulin with a shovel standing in it. The floor falls to a drain in the middle and everything in here is hosed at the end of the day, in a fixed order, which he learned from his father and has never once varied.
name: The Codfather — The Ice Room
